import importlib.util, pathlib, sys, unittest
import torch
ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[6] / 'stage2_RQ-VAE/TIGER_c117_global_sinkhorn_poincare'
# Resolve from the source tree, without depending on the caller's cwd.
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from model.hyperbolic import project_ball, squared_distance
from model.poincare_residual import sinkhorn_log
from model.model import RQVAE
from types import SimpleNamespace

class GeometryGradientTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_curved_distance_gradcheck_and_independent_finite_difference(self):
        x = torch.tensor([[0.12, -0.08]], dtype=torch.double, requires_grad=True)
        y = torch.tensor([[-0.03, 0.09]], dtype=torch.double, requires_grad=True)
        fn = lambda a, b: squared_distance(a, b, c=1.0)
        self.assertTrue(torch.autograd.gradcheck(fn, (x, y), eps=1e-6, atol=2e-5, rtol=2e-4))
        grad, = torch.autograd.grad(fn(x, y).sum(), (x,))
        eps = 1e-6
        with torch.no_grad():
            xp=x.detach().clone(); xm=x.detach().clone(); xp[0,0]+=eps; xm[0,0]-=eps
            fd=(fn(xp,y.detach()).item()-fn(xm,y.detach()).item())/(2*eps)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(grad[0,0].item(), fd, delta=2e-5)
        self.assertGreater(abs(grad[0,0].item()), 1e-5)

    def test_flat_limit_gradient_and_projection_chain(self):
        x=torch.tensor([[0.2,-0.1]],dtype=torch.double,requires_grad=True)
        y=torch.tensor([[-0.05,0.04]],dtype=torch.double,requires_grad=True)
        out=squared_distance(project_ball(x,0.9),project_ball(y,0.9),c=0.0).sum()
        gx,gy=torch.autograd.grad(out,(x,y))
        expected=8*(x.detach()-y.detach())
        torch.testing.assert_close(gx,expected)
        torch.testing.assert_close(gy,-expected)
        self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(gx).all().item())

class ModelGradientTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def _model(self):
        cfg=SimpleNamespace(hidden_sizes=[5,4],dropout=0.0,codebook_num=3,codebook_size=[4,4,4],codebook_dim=4,curvature=1.0,radius=0.9)
        torch.manual_seed(17)
        return RQVAE(cfg,in_dim=5).double()

    def test_real_forward_reconstruction_assignment_balance_gradients(self):
        model=self._model()
        emb=torch.tensor([[.1,.2,-.3,.4,.2],[-.2,.1,.3,-.1,.5],[.4,-.2,.2,.1,-.3],[.3,.1,-.1,.2,.4]],dtype=torch.double)
        with torch.no_grad():
            for cb in model.rq.codebooks: cb.copy_(torch.randn_like(cb)*.12)
            model.refresh_assignment(emb)
        codes=model.frozen_codes.clone(); transport=model.frozen_transport.clone()
        self.assertFalse(codes.requires_grad); self.assertFalse(transport.requires_grad)
        total,rec,assign,bal,tr=model(emb)
        self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(torch.stack([total,rec,assign,bal,tr])).all().item())
        self.assertGreater(rec.item(),0.0); self.assertGreater(assign.item(),0.0)
        self.assertGreater(bal.item(),-1e-8)
        total.backward()
        self.assertIsNotNone(model.encoder.mlp[1].weight.grad)
        self.assertGreater(model.encoder.mlp[1].weight.grad.norm().item(),1e-8)
        for cb in model.rq.codebooks:
            self.assertIsNotNone(cb.grad)
            self.assertGreater(cb.grad.norm().item(),1e-8)
        self.assertTrue(torch.equal(codes,model.frozen_codes))
        self.assertTrue(torch.equal(transport,model.frozen_transport))

    def test_transition_target_and_detached_transport_negative_controls(self):
        model=self._model()
        emb=torch.tensor([[.1,.2,-.3,.4,.2],[-.2,.1,.3,-.1,.5],[.4,-.2,.2,.1,-.3],[.3,.1,-.1,.2,.4]],dtype=torch.double)
        with torch.no_grad():
            for cb in model.rq.codebooks: cb.copy_(torch.randn_like(cb)*.12)
            model.refresh_assignment(emb)
        r=torch.full((2,4),.25,dtype=torch.double)
        _,_,_,_,tr=model(emb[:2],edges=(emb[2:],r))
        self.assertGreater(tr.item(),0.0)
        model.zero_grad(set_to_none=True); tr.backward()
        self.assertGreater(model.rq.codebooks[2].grad.norm().item(),1e-8)
        self.assertIsNone(model.rq.codebooks[0].grad)
        # Frozen targets must not acquire gradients or create a target-side graph.
        q=model.frozen_transport.detach().clone().requires_grad_(True)
        logits=torch.randn(2,4,dtype=torch.double,requires_grad=True)
        loss=-(q[:2]*torch.log_softmax(logits,dim=1)).sum()
        gq,gl=torch.autograd.grad(loss,(q,logits),allow_unused=True)
        self.assertIsNotNone(gq); self.assertIsNotNone(gl)
        # Explicitly detached target is the required negative control.
        detached=q.detach()
        loss2=-(detached[:2]*torch.log_softmax(logits,dim=1)).sum()
        self.assertIsNone(torch.autograd.grad(loss2,q,allow_unused=True)[0])

    def test_nan_input_is_not_silently_accepted(self):
        x=torch.tensor([[float('nan'),0.1]],requires_grad=True)
        y=torch.zeros_like(x)
        d=squared_distance(x,y,c=1.0)
        self.assertFalse(torch.isfinite(d).all().item())
        # NaN must propagate through the objective derivative, not masquerade as zero.
        g,=torch.autograd.grad(d.sum(),x)
        self.assertFalse(torch.isfinite(g).all().item())
